summary: Joint Stock Company Kaspi.kz filed a Form 6-K announcing results of its extraordinary general meeting held on June 11, 2026. Shareholders approved a dividend of KZT 850 per common share for 1Q 2026, payable in cash by wire transfer starting June 11, 2026, to holders of record on June 10, 2026. The meeting also approved the election of three members to the Counting commission. This is a routine capital return event, not triggering a special-situation category. No other strategic action (e.g., merger, tender, spinoff) is present.
